summary: Part 3 (13:57 to 18:02) of the 3.0 Buybox (KAMs) video walks through the price-drop tabs of the Google Sheet 'Smart Cell x Revibe'. The AE tool (title 'UAE & ZA') and the SA tool (title 'KSA') list SKUs where a seller has a price but is not winning, split into a small price drop table (under 20 AED) and a big price drop table (over 20 AED). The trainer works through one price-to-win example (Price AE 296, Buybox AE 290, Price to win AE 285, Price drop required 11), explains that the seller ticks Accept? and presses a purple button that runs a script (Google authorization is sometimes asked for), and says that Show edit history and a Log tab (which he says is hidden from sellers) can be used to trace changes. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened and checked. Many pack frame names were attached to the wrong screens and were re-matched by reading the images. The claim that the SKU was removed from the list is not supported by the frames and was removed. The Buybox cell reverted from 285 to 296 between 16:20 and 16:40, which the trainer does not explain and is logged as unclear.

asr_fixes.basis: The narration uses decimals; the sheet shows integer values 296, 290 and 285. The sheet values are used here. The unit is unresolved (see unclear).
Buybox tab Buybox AE value for the example SKU row (row 9823) shows 290.

unclear.issue: Narration says the tool exists in 'uae and saudi'. The AE tool title reads 'UAE & ZA' with a UAE flag and a second flag, and the SA tool title reads 'KSA' with one green flag. The trainer does not state which countries each tab covers.
Units. Narration says 2.96, 2.90, 2.85 and a drop of 11. The sheet shows 296, 290, 285 and 11 with no currency or decimal unit. The unit of the sheet values is not stated.
'nearest factor of five': the rule's exact direction (below or above the buy box) is not stated in this part. The example has the price to win 5 below the buy box, but this is not spoken explicitly.
Bucket edges: the sheet headers say '<20 AED' and '>20 AED'. A price drop of exactly 20 AED is not covered by either bucket as described.

Trainer says the SKU 'got removed' from the list. Not confirmed: Buybox row 9823 is still listed at 16:17 and 16:20 (t00977, t00980), and AE tool row 5 (08-798-206-15-30) is still listed with Price AE 296, Price to win 285 and Accept? ticked at 17:32 (t01052).

Timing '{hour?}' is low-confidence. The narration says the next price is 284, but the screen shows 285 at 16:20 (t00980). Whether the price changes after a delay, and what 284 refers to, is unresolved.

'when the seller asks for this authorization to be authorized': unclear who grants the authorization (the seller or Revibe staff) and when it is needed. The narration says 'sometimes', not 'the first run'.
'if the seller used some price functions' and 'price lock': the price functions are not defined in this part.
Sentence is cut off: 'if they want to get more'. The benefit the seller gets from more details is not stated.
'in these two tabs': assumed to mean the AE tool and SA tool; the trainer does not confirm it. The transcript does not say the same log exists for Saudi SKUs.
Log tab is said to be hidden from sellers. No hidden state is shown on screen; a partly visible Sheets tooltip starting 'Sheet hid...' appears at 17:24 (t01044) and is cut off.

Part 3 transcript ends at 17:54 with 'has only a small price drop to accept below 20 dirhams and the ones where the seller has'. The rest of the sentence about the big bucket is not in the evidence pack (part ends 18:02).

The 14 October example SKU and its before and after prices are not spoken clearly, so the example cannot be confirmed. The frame shown at 17:08 is a Price Lock row (t01028), not a small price drop row. The edit history on the Buybox tab (285 replaced with 296, October 14) is the only October 14 example on screen.
The Buybox cell U9823 shows 285 at 16:20 (t00980) and 296 again at 16:40-16:50 (t01000, t01008). The trainer does not explain the change. The popover 'Replaced 285 with 296' is dated October 14.
